notes.title: Episode 37
notes.notes: It's time for another episode of Finding Fate. This time Fate investigates an old cold case. Can she solve it?

notes.title: Episode 36
notes.notes:
It's time for another episode of Finding Fate! This time the search for her father continues, with exciting new developments and clues being uncovered. 

Have fun with Finding Fate, and see you again for the next episode :-)

notes.title: Episode 35
notes.notes: Episode 35 is here! This time Fate is working on a fun story about Aprils Fools, but maybe things aren't what they seem to be? We hope you have fun with this exciting episode of Finding Fate.

notes.title: Episode 34
notes.notes: It's time to continue the adventures of Fate. In this episode she finally continues the search for her father. Enjoy!

notes.title: Episode 33 is out!
notes.notes: It's time to continue the adventures of Fate. What will she uncover this time? Enjoy episode 33.

notes.title: Episode 32
notes.notes:
It's Christmas, and time for another episode of Finding Fate. This time Fate visits a ski resort, and of course she drops right into a mystery for you to solve. 

We hope you enjoy this episode, and wish you all a very merry Christmas!

notes.title: Episode 31
notes.notes: It's time for episode 31! Fate is back from Japan, and new leads on the whereabouts of her father has emerged. Enjoy this exciting episode!

notes.title: Episode 30
notes.notes: Hello Fate fans - episode 30 has just been released! In this episode Fate travels to Japan to visit a friend - and to no surprise, the finds a mystery there as well. Enjoy!

notes.title: Episode 29
notes.notes: It's time for episode 29! This time Fate resumes the search for her father, and the gang he was part of. Have fun, and let us know if there is anything we can improve.

notes.title: Episode 28
notes.notes:
It's time episode 28 of Finding Fate! This time she attempts to solve the mystery of a missing author. Can you help her? 

Have fun, and enjoy this new episode :-)

notes.title: Episode 27 is here!
notes.notes: After a short break, Fate is back on the search for her past. Enjoy the new episode, and be sure to leave a review if you like the game.

notes.title: Episode 26 - out now!
notes.notes:
Episode 26 is available to play now. In this episode Fate investigates a mysterious stalker - can you help her solve the case?

Best of luck, we hope you will enjoy this episode.

notes.title: Episode 25
notes.notes: The adventures of Fate continues in episode 25 - out now!

notes.title: Episode 24!
notes.notes: We just released episode 24 of this exciting saga. Help Fate as she returns to work on an important case.

notes.title: Episode 22 is live!
notes.notes:
Fate is getting very close to finally finding her mother. Could this be it? 

Please enjoy episode 22, and be sure to leave a review if you do.

notes.title: Episode 21 - Christmas Episode
notes.notes:
It's Christmas, and that means a special Christmas mission for Fate. This time she will have to solve the mystery of the missing Starlight Gem.

Merry Christmas, Fate fans :-)

notes.title: Episode 20 has been released!
notes.notes: We have just released episode 20, where Fate continues to investigate the history of her parents.

notes.title: New episode - Halloween special!
notes.notes:
Fate investigates a mysterious cult, in this months special Halloween episode!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Episode 18 is out now!
notes.notes: Episode 18 of Finding Fate has been released. In this exciting new episode Fate tries to solve a cold case about a missing doctor.

notes.title: Episode 17
notes.notes:
Finally the time has come once more: a brand new episode of Finding Fate is now available! Follow along as Fate continues to investigate her past. Where will her journey take her? Hop in the game and find out!

And of course the weekly challenges have also been added. Can you obtain the gold medals in these brand new levels?

notes.title: Episode 16 out now!
notes.notes:
It's time for another episode of Finding Fate! This time Fate investigates a mysterious jewelry theft - can she solve the case?

As every week, new challenges are also available now.

notes.title: Episode 15 available now
notes.notes:
Episode 15 is available now. It continues the story of Fate and her past.

The five new weekly challenges has also been added.
